victim_deposited.meaning: Victim has deposited funds into the vault

attacker_approved.meaning: Victim has approved the attacker as spender

attacker_call.meaning: Attacker calls withdraw()/redeem() passing the victim's address as the owner parameter

withdraw_completed.meaning: withdraw()/redeem() call completes against the victim's position

caller_authorized.meaning: Caller authorization holds (msg.sender == owner or allowance[owner][msg.sender] >= shares)

preconditions.text: Victim has deposited funds, victim holds validator-granted self-allowance, victim has not approved the attacker, and attacker calls withdraw()/redeem() with the victim's address as owner.
preconditions.derivation: Conjunction of asserted preconditions victim_deposited, victim_has_self_allowance, no_approval_to_attacker and the prior input observation attacker_calls_withdraw_redeem. Assumption assets_sent_to_attacker is excluded from P (post-effect transfer) and named in unresolved.

safety.text: If the withdraw()/redeem() call completes against the victim's position, then caller authorization held.
safety.derivation: Protected-effect construction (effect -> authorized) derived from security_intent statement caller_authorization_intent, which grounds the ERC-4626 requirement that caller authorization be verified when msg.sender != owner.

effects.text: The withdraw()/redeem() call completes against the victim's position and caller authorization did not hold.
effects.derivation: Direct impact statement unauthorized_state_change: the call completes against the victim's position while the victim's authorization is absent.

effect_coverage.reason: Effect modeled as withdraw_completed AND NOT caller_authorized from the asserted impact statement.
100% drain is an aggregate/percentage claim with no quantity observables and depends on the unspecified asset transfer destination; deferred to limitations.

assumptions: Caller authorization is observed as a Boolean outcome of the cited ERC-4626 check; allowance/shares quantities are not modeled.
The validator-granted self-allowance is active; the module granting it is out of scope.
No approval from the victim to the attacker and no user interaction occur before the call.
unresolved: assets_sent_to_attacker: the withdrawn-assets destination (owner vs caller) is unspecified; it cannot be a ground precondition without asserting the harmful transfer.
Whether msg.sender is the owner or an approved spender in the reported scenario is not stated.
Exact spendSelfAllowance() semantics are not detailed.
Deployment and reachability of WERC7575Vault at the reported time are not asserted.

limitations: Share/allowance quantities and vault balances are not represented; no quantitative bound for the 100% drain (e_f5f848436b92_0012) is asserted.
Downstream asset transfer to the attacker is deferred; the actual recipient of withdrawn assets is unspecified.
The ERC-4626 caller-authorization requirement is inferred, not directly observed at runtime.
Economic loss and any subsequent effects are not quantified.
Only the single core unauthorized-withdrawal scenario is formalized; other approval-based paths are out of scope.
